# Workspace Instructions

- Project type: Python Playwright automation framework.
- Run tests with `python -m pytest`; use `scripts/run-tests.bat` on Windows or `scripts/run-tests.sh` on Linux/macOS for browser-specific runs.
- Keep Page Objects in `pages/`, test services in `test_framework/`, configuration in `config/`, and test data in `data/`.
- Validate Python changes with the smallest relevant Pytest selection before completing work.
